senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) tiger or leopard. Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᶜ top, v. חוּשׁ II.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:4">Snh. I, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:4">B. Kam. I, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01186"><he>בַּרְדְּלִיס</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>נְמֵרִים</he>.
Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45; a. e.—[From Sabb. 107ᵇ, ref. to Jer. XIII, 23, it would appear that נמר, in Talmudic days, meant leopard.]
